content: प्रस्तारः .²1 Strewing, spreading out, covering with. .²2 A bed of leaves and flowers. .²3 A bed or couch in general. .²4 A flat surface, level, plain. .²5 A thicket, wood. .²6 (In prosody) A tabular representation of the long and short vowels of a metre with all possible varieties. .²7 A process in preparing minerals. .²8 A flight of steps (leading down to water; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>घाट</ns>); मणिप्रवालप्रस्तारम् <ls>Mb. 3. 145. 50</ls>.
